verdict.rationale: Base44 is explicitly a prompt-to-app builder with a managed backend: docs state you describe what you want and AI updates code, styles, components, and the backend is auto-defined in code/config (base44-docs-31, docs-33, docs-29, docs-17), with an SDK/CLI for entities/CRUD (docs-28, docs-23) showing generated backend logic alongside UI. Community reports corroborate that a single prompt/session produces a fully functional app end-to-end (base44-comm-5, base44-comm-6). Missing for 10: no detailed technical breakdown of how a single literal prompt maps to both layers simultaneously, and some community skepticism about complexity/cost at scale (base44-comm-8) tempers full confidence.
